description: Source code for a web scraper class 'TheCookingGuy' that extracts recipe information from 'thecookingguy.com'. It defines methods to get recipe yields, ingredients, ingredient groups, instructions, description, and site name, utilizing external utility functions and handling HTML parsing.

classes.name: TheCookingGuy
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from the 'thecookingguy.com' website.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the website.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Raises exception indicating total time info is not provided.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Extracts and returns the recipe yields.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts and returns a list of ingredients.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients by purpose if specified, otherwise returns ungrouped ingredients.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts and returns recipe instructions as a string.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Extracts and returns the recipe description.

methods.name: site_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the site.
